mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE user_menus AS ( SELECT DISTINCT m.id, m.parent_id FROM sys_menu m INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.id = rm.menu_id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON rm.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = 1 AND m.deleted = 0 UNION SELECT p.id, p.parent_id FROM sys_menu p INNER JOIN user_menus um ON p.id = um.parent_id WHERE p.status = 1 AND p.deleted = 0 ) SELECT DISTINCT m.* FROM sys_menu m INNER JOIN user_menus um ON m.id = um.id ORDER BY m.sort_order
SELECT menu_id FROM sys_role_menu WHERE role_id = #{roleId}
SELECT m.* FROM sys_menu m INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.id = rm.menu_id WHERE rm.role_id = #{roleId} AND m.status = 1 AND m.deleted = 0 ORDER BY m.sort_order
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_menu WHERE parent_id = #{menuId} AND deleted = 0
